## Description

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)

## How Has This Been Tested?
Describe the testing performed to verify this change:
- [ ] Tested locally with `npm run dev` on `http://localhost:3000`
- [ ] Verified build succeeds with `npm run build`
- [ ] Verified in browser: Chrome / Edge / Firefox / Safari
- [ ] Tested both Borrower and Lender flows
